narrative.intro: Loyal Source Government Services has $1.8B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Loyal Source Government Services won 17 awards in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $109M, and obligations are up 105.1% year over year. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer: the Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $1.8B in FY2026 to date. Other buying agencies in FY2026 to date include the Department of Homeland Security with $75.8M and the Department of Defense with $1.4M. On the market side, Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) accounts for $1.8B, Temporary Help Services accounts for $75.2M, and Offices of All Other Miscellaneous Health Practitioners accounts for $1.3M in FY2026 to date. Fiscal-year obligations show a multi-year series: FY21 $244M, FY22 $173M, FY23 $374M, FY24 $546M, FY25 $900M, and FY26 $1.8B. The current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date.
